newsitem.title: USA: Kaiser buys 1.587 mln shrs PetroCorp.
newsitem.headline: Kaiser buys 1.587 mln shrs PetroCorp.

text.p: PetroCorp Inc said on Tuesday that Kaiser-Francis Oil Co has become its largest shareholder after buying 1,587,157 PetroCorp shares from LS Holding Co, a subsidiary of CIGNA Corp.

The shares were bought for $8.25 per share, PetroCorp said. The figure represents 18.5 percent of PetroCorp's outstanding shares and raises Kaiser's total ownership of PetroCorp to 47.7 percent of shares outstanding, PetroCorp said.
PetroCorp said that Kaiser-Francis's interest is for investment purposes and that it has "no intentions of attempting to effect any change in the management, business plan or policies of PetroCorp."
The company also said CIGNA's sale of its shares complete CIGNA's strategy to exit its oil and gas investments.
